case_title: LOUIE, GILBERT VS HERTZ RENT-A-CAR/ ADMINISTRATION DEPT.

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $600.00 FILED BY LOUIE, GILBERT AS TO DEFENDANT HERTZ RENT-A-CAR/ ADMINISTRATION DEPT. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-24-1994 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 01
SMALL CLAIMS DISPOSITION OCT-24-1994, CONTINUED BY COURT TO DEC-12-1994 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 01

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LOUIE, GILBERT IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT HERTZ RENT-A-CAR/ ADMINISTRATION DEPT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
